info.description: Homerun's REST API : a thin JSON wrapper over the DTO layer, meant for a future CLI (see the `cli/` sub-project) and any other external client. Requests are the same zod schemas that validate them server-side; every route also requires a cookie session or an `x-api-key`/`Authorization: Bearer` API key (see hooks.server.ts).
info.title: Homerun API

post.description: Persists config only : does not deploy. Call POST /services/{serviceId}/deploy afterward to actually pull/build and start it.
